question: Unsa ang mga requirements, pila ang bayad kada hektarya, ug pila ka adlaw makuha ang Zoning Certification sa CPDO?
answer: Sa CPDO, ang mga requirements sa Zoning Certification sa isang hektare na lupa ay hindi nakalistado sa mga nakapag-aralan nga impormasyon. Ang bayad sa Zoning Certification ay hindi rin nakalalabas sa mga nakapag-aralan. Ang mga adlaw para makuha ang Zoning Certification ay nasa 2 araw sa pag-sign ng certification ng Division Chief of GIS ([S1] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0003-C002) at 2 days depending upon the availability of Zoning Administrator ([S1] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0003-C002). Ang ibang adlaw na nakalalabas sa mga nakapag-aralan ay 25 minutes para sa pre-evaluation ng submitted documents ([S2] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0003-C001), 20 minutes para sa encoding sa document tracking system at endorsement ng application sa GIS ([S2] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0003-C001), at 5 hours para sa re-evaluation ng documents at preparation ng Zoning Certification ([S1] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0003-C002).

ground_truth: The CPDO Zoning Enforcement Division issues Zoning Certification based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028). The checklist requires: Certified True Copy of Title(s), 1 photocopy, from the Registry of Deeds; duly accomplished application form, 1 original, from CPDO; Subdivision/Sketch Plan, 1 original, from Bureau of Land/private Geodetic Engineer; Order of Payment, 1 original, from CPDO; and Official Receipt, 1 original, from the City Treasurer's Office. The zoning fee is PHP 750 per hectare; the payment step depends on CTO processing time, described as uncontrollable time. The charter lists a TOTAL processing time of 3 Days, 6 Hours, and 50 Minutes.
